issues.body: In test_guards_reading_a_release_workflow_run_outside_the_selector, `if not runners: continue` makes the central safety check fail open. If a guard that reads an allowlisted release workflow is removed from docs-quality.yml (or otherwise ceases to be invoked by any workflow), it is skipped rather than rejected. The final `checked > 0` is global, so guards for other release files can keep the test green. This contradicts the documented obligation that the release-lane entries' own guards still run and permits an allowlisted workflow to lose its validating lane silently.
issues.fix_hint: Treat a discovered guard with no workflow runners as a failure, and enforce coverage per allowlisted release workflow (or, preferably, maintain an explicit release-workflow-to-required-guard mapping and assert every required guard is invoked by at least one non-selector-gated workflow). Keep a per-entry non-vacuity assertion so coverage for one workflow cannot mask missing coverage for another.
issues.title: Release guard audit ignores guards that are no longer run

verdict.summary: The allowlist behavior itself is pinned, but the new test intended to prove that release-workflow guards remain active has a fail-open gap. It explicitly ignores a guard when no workflow invokes it, so removing the non-selector-gated invocation that justifies this carve-out can leave the test green. Because this invariant is the stated safety basis for skipping the full matrix, the change is not yet sound as scoped.
